title: Conditional constant-model transport for one finite quotient
statement: Given core origin data on V, an etale Z→V, an algebraic complex E and an isomorphism from the restriction of the descended level to the constant E model on Z, every proetale W→Z receives an isomorphism from constantAdicQuotientRealization(W≫g,d,n)(E) to the actual inverse image of K.

proof.text: Apply the monic-and-epic comparison morphism supplied by the split-off construction. The derived module category is balanced, so isIso_of_mono_of_epi turns that morphism into an isomorphism and asIso gives the required Nonempty witness.

proof_origin.place: Tag 09C6; balanced-category assembly from the comparison-morphism step

lean.statement:
theorem lisse_finite_quotient_etale_origin_transport
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} {g : Y ⟶ X}
    {A : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing A] {d : AdicCoefficientDatum A} {n : ℕ}
    {K : DerivedCategory (pbcModules X ((pbcAdicRings X d).obj (op n)))}
    {V : Y.Etale}
    (C : LisseFiniteQuotientEtaleOriginCore X Y g d n K V)
    (Z : V.left.Etale)
    (E : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (AdicCompletion d.ideal A ⧸
      (d.ideal.map (algebraMap A (AdicCompletion d.ideal A))) ^ (n + 1))))
    (hE : Nonempty ((AlgebraicGeometry.Etale.upperStar _ Z.hom).mapDerivedCategory.obj
        C.level ≅ (constantSheaf Z.left.smallEtaleTopology _).mapDerivedCategory.obj E))
    (W : Y.ProEt) (_w : W ⟶ (toProEt Y).obj (Etale.mk (Z.hom ≫ V.hom))) :
    Nonempty ((constantAdicQuotientRealization (W.hom ≫ g) d n).obj E ≅
      (adicTowerPullback (W.hom ≫ g)
        ((pbcAdicRings X d).obj (op n))).obj K)
